name: Tripp Lake Camp
description_short: Traditional full-summer overnight camp for girls ages 7-16 on a lake in Poland, Maine, operating since 1911. Campers stay for the full season, with activities in arts, land sports, waterfront, outdoor living, horseback riding and theatre.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp sits on a lake with a mile-long waterfront and offers a waterfront program. The page does not describe swim instruction or safety details.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Dates & Tuition at Tripp Lake Camp | A Kids Camp in Poland, Maine

warnings: Only one full season is offered (June 26 to August 12, 2027). Shorter stays may be allowed in rare cases by contacting the camp; no dates or prices are given for those.
